name: shad-env
description: An interface for drawing via pre-defined shaders
details:
Drawing Order:
- Primarily ordered by z-value with lower z-values drawn first
- secondarily ordered by index with first-added = first-drawn

State:
- compiled shaders held in a Map<string,Shader> keyed by <shader-handle>

add-shad.name: add-shad
add-shad.effect: binds the shader to the area defined by the given coordinates
add-shad.details:
- potentially compiles the shader?
- z-value is 0 by default
- z-value is a float but decimal not required in this syntax
